name: slumbering_cerberus_stays_tapped_in_your_untap_step
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'This creature doesn't untap during your untap step. Morbid — At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, untap this creature.' The Cerberus attacks on turn 1 (seat 1 takes 4) and stays tapped. No creature dies in turns 1, 2 or 3, so morbid never untaps it, and seat 0's untap step in turn 3 leaves it tapped; seat 0's Bear, tapped too, untaps there.
